_note: GAM Research forecast drivers for Gabriel India, consolidated, Rs crore, on the post-scheme basis: FY26 is the company's restated year (pooling, Q1FY27 results) and the Mar-26 balance sheet is pro forma for the scheme and Project Jupiter (GABRIEL.patch.js); all per-share figures use the 19.16 cr shares in issue on 30-Sep-2026. Revenue growth and EBITDA margin come from the two-part entity build below (standalone; subsidiaries), synced by GABRIEL.ctx.js. Other income = recurring other income + the share of profit of the equity-accounted JVs and associates (Dana Anand 25.1%, Henkel Anand 49%, SK Enmove Gabriel 49%, HL Mando Anand 28.99% from 11-Sep-2026, HL Klemove India ~30% from Sep-2026), built in jvBuild. That share is already after tax, so the tax line carries operating tax on profit before the JV share plus minorities (no minority line in the engine): taxRate is the resulting effective rate, synced by the ctx file. The JV stakes sit in Investments, so the engine's 'treasury' is net cash plus the stakes at book.
_marginWhy: From the entity build. Restated FY26 9.6%, Q1FY27 8.7% (commodity inflation, lagged recoveries, sunroof disruption).
_capexWhy: Standalone Rs160-190 cr in FY27 (CFO, Q4FY26 call; ~Rs190 cr in FY26) plus subsidiaries (IGSS second line, Jinhap fasteners, ACYM) ~Rs70-90 cr. Consolidated FY24-26 capex Rs163 / 209 / 240 cr (Screener, pre-scheme).
_depWhy: Restated FY26 depreciation Rs123.6 cr; Q1FY27 Rs32.3 cr (Rs129 cr annualised). The engine (and Excel) depreciate the reported gross block (Rs1,273 cr at Mar-26, before the scheme's Anchemco and ACYM assets) and hold CWIP flat, so 9.3% gives ~Rs130 cr in FY27E, in line with the run-rate, rising with capex.
_treasuryWhy: Zero: "treasury" in this model is net cash plus ~Rs3,700 cr of JV/associate stakes and ~Rs313 cr of the scheme's operating net assets (engine workaround in GABRIEL.patch.js). The stakes' income is the share of profit in jvBuild; interest on the small cash balance is in recurringOI.
_otherIncomeWhy: Built, not plugged (synced from jvBuild by GABRIEL.ctx.js): recurring other income + share of JV/associate profit. Restated FY26 Rs186.3 cr = other income Rs28.6 cr + JV share Rs157.6 cr; Q1FY27 Rs47.4 cr (Rs4.6 + Rs42.7 cr).
_recurringWhy: FY26 as reported Rs26.3 cr (AR note 32): FD interest Rs9.5 cr, mutual-fund gains Rs4.3 cr, miscellaneous Rs8.0 cr, PPE gain Rs1.6 cr (one-off), rent and others; restated Rs28.6 cr; Q1FY27 Rs4.6 cr. After Rs1,061 cr was paid out for Jupiter, cash is ~Rs150-250 cr: Rs18 / 14 / 16 cr.

jvBuild._note: Gabriel's share of each JV/associate's profit after tax (Rs crore). base = 100% FY26 PAT (decks, KPMG/BDO report); growth = our PAT growth; months = months owned in the year.

items.name: Dana Anand (25.1%)
items._why: Axles, driveshafts, EV transmissions for UVs, CVs, tractors; FY23-26 PAT 228 / 319 / 319 / 352 (ROE 33%); grows with UV and CV production; Dana's parent merging with Eaton Mobility is a watch-point (call).

items.name: Henkel Anand (49%)
items._why: Body-in-white and NVH adhesives; PAT 40 / 121 / 161 / 142 (FY26 down on commodity costs, recoveries due); 96% OEM.

items.name: SK Enmove Gabriel (49%)
items._why: Lubricants JV started 27-Feb-2026; start-up losses assumed (abs = Gabriel's share, Rs cr).

items.name: HL Mando Anand (28.99%)
items._why: Brakes, steering, suspension; FY26 revenue Rs5,886 cr, PAT Rs358 cr, net worth Rs1,924 cr; ~40% of sales to non-Korean OEMs, exports 7-8% (call). Owned from 11-Sep-2026 (6.6 months of FY27). ICICI Securities' FY28E share Rs155 cr implies ~22% a year; we take 12%.

items.name: HL Klemove India (~30%)
items._why: ADAS (radar, cameras); revenue Rs691 / 800 / 1,049 cr in FY24-26, adjusted EBITDA ~Rs129 cr in FY26 (call); PAT not disclosed: we assume 55% of adjusted EBITDA (Rs71 cr). Content Rs20,000-70,000 per vehicle; Mahindra and Tata business won. Assumed owned from mid-Sep-2026.

_interestLabel: Interest (8.15% NCDs from Sep-2026, Anchemco and subsidiary debt, leases)
_interestWhy: Restated FY26 Rs26.4 cr; Q1FY27 Rs6.0 cr. Rs1,000 cr NCDs at 8.15% from 10-Sep-2026 (Rs81.5 cr a year; ~Rs46 cr in FY27) plus ~Rs24 cr on other debt and leases: Rs72 cr FY27E, Rs104 cr FY28E, Rs98 cr FY29E as cash pays down short-term debt. The Rs237 cr deferred HL Klemove payment carries no interest.
_taxWhy: Effective rate on PBT incl. the (already taxed) JV share, synced by the ctx file: operating tax 25.2% on PBT before the JV share (restated FY26: Rs91.0 cr on Rs365.6 cr = 24.9%) plus minorities (ACYM 24%, Jinhap 49%: Rs1.6 cr in FY26, Rs0.8 cr in Q1FY27; Rs4 / 6 / 8 cr). Restated FY26 effective 17.4%.
_payoutWhy: FY26 DPS Rs5.0 = 21% of restated EPS (Rs24.29); 28-32% of reported EPS in FY24-25. Leverage after Jupiter argues for no increase.

build._note: Entity build (Rs crore). Standalone = ride control + Anchemco fluids (restated FY26 Rs4,577.3 cr, EBITDA Rs409.1 cr = 8.9%; Q1FY27 Rs1,274.2 cr, 8.4%). Subsidiaries and consolidation = consolidated less standalone (IGSS sunroofs Rs434 cr at 15.1%, ACYM Rs235 cr at 10.2%, Jinhap, GEEC, eliminations): FY26 Rs667.9 cr, EBITDA Rs93.0 cr (13.9%); Q1FY27 Rs151.4 cr, Rs17.0 cr (11.2%).
build._why: Standalone: Q1FY27 +18.9% on 2W +23%, PV +17%, CV +15% production and aftermarket +54%; FY27E +16% as the base hardens after the Sep-2025 GST cut and PV share slipped (model mix); FY28-29E +11% / +10% (industry 7-9% plus content: EV 2W, UV share of business 65%, railways, exports to 10%, solar dampers). Margin 8.9% in FY26, 8.4% in Q1 (commodities, lagged recoveries): 8.8% / 9.2% / 9.4%. Subsidiaries: sunroofs lost 15-20k units in Q1 (Creta), to be recovered; second 2 lakh line from FY26; fasteners ramp; +12% / 16% / 14%; margin 11.2% in Q1, 13.9% in FY26: 12.5% / 13.5% / 14%.

dcf._betaWhy: Beta 1.0 (Ke 12.5%): cyclical auto volumes, but diversified across 2W, PV, CV and the aftermarket. Net debt (ex the JV stakes) is ~Rs1,200 cr, ~5% of enterprise value, so a WACC would be only slightly lower; the engine discounts at the cost of equity.
dcf._tgWhy: 5.5%: India vehicle demand and content growth.
dcf._fadeGrowthWhy: Revenue growth fades from ~10% to 8% over 15 years.
dcf._fadeCapexWhy: Capex 3.5% of revenue in steady state (FY24-26 4-5%); depreciation 2.5%.
dcf._jvNote: FCFF excludes the JV share of profit; the JV stakes enter at book value through net cash (stake at cost plus accumulated share of profit), which understates Dana and Henkel (book ~Rs395 cr).

bull.label: Bull
bull.narrative: Vehicle production stays strong, Gabriel wins back PV share, sunroofs and fasteners ramp faster and commodity recoveries come through: revenue growth ~3pp a year higher and EBITDA margin +0.6pp.

bear.label: Bear
bear.narrative: A two-wheeler slowdown after the GST-cut boost, further PV share loss, commodity costs not recovered and IGSS diluted to 65%: revenue growth ~4pp a year lower and EBITDA margin -1.0pp.

methods.name: P/E
methods.why: How the street values Gabriel: P/E on FY28E EPS (Motilal Oswal ~40x, ICICI Securities ~40x, Choice 32x). Multiple derived in GABRIEL.ctx.js (own forward-P/E median since the scheme was announced x the same-window auto-component move) and written by syncMultiples().

methods.name: EV/EBITDA
methods.why: Own trailing EV/EBITDA median since the scheme x the same sector move, restated to Sep-28E EBITDA; net cash and the JV stakes at book added.

methods.name: DCF
methods.why: 15-year FCFF of the consolidated operations at Ke 12.5% and 5.5% terminal growth, plus net cash and the JV stakes at book.
